name: Spicy Garlic Oil
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ gallon flavorless high smoke point oil, such as canola, peanut, safflower, grapeseed, or soybean
8 Thai bird chiles, stemmed and halved

steps: Combine all ingredients in a large stockpot.
Heat over low heat for 1 hour.
Strain, cool, and store in the refrigerator until oil smells off, looks smoky, or tastes rancid.
